rows: Moves: shifts the mood of existing things
Cheap near your mood, dear far from it
Makes: conjures what you remember; raises Coherence, heals, repairs
Your mood; too much power risks cracking the bead

A memory is a bead: it gives the shape, and what you feed decides how the conjuration feels and behaves. Vividness sets detail and duration; faint memories give illusions. Resonance: feed material in the memory's own ratio; only that ratio works, and nothing in the bead is used up. Healing and repair need a match. Burning: burns a memory, its material pouring straight into your mood at the cost of the mood capacity it gave, leaving you Ablaze; heavy Attention. Memories can't be forged
Unmakes: dissolves form, freeing feeling as ambient emotion; lowers Coherence, makes things forget, undoes conjurations and weakly held things
Draws no Attention directly, though the feeling it frees can cancel into lucidity and flare it. Calls on Forgetting, the dark that erodes what is unlit. Provisional
